attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (RHEL9, static binaries + systemd unit, firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened), seeded it with application keys under /app/*, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped /var/lib/etcd, ran `member remove` from a surviving quorum of node1+node2 while confirming reads/health stayed up), and replaced it with a working member on the same node3 host via `member add` + ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing, restoring a healthy 3/3 cluster with all original keys intact. Then ran the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes sequentially (native `reboot` via systemd-run timer so the ack returned first), proving changed boot IDs and full post-restart etcd/cluster/data recovery on each node before moving to the next, preserving quorum throughout.
